footnote: Source: Chinese Pharmaceutical Association, draft standard on weight-loss drugs in hospitals (June 26, 2026)
notes: Beyond reviewing prescriptions, pharmacists also guard against misuse. These steps come from the Chinese Pharmaceutical Association's draft standard posted in June 2026. It is still a draft for comment, and we propose following it until the final version appears. First, screen for drug misuse risk at the first visit with the DAST-10 questionnaire. Second, the draft asks hospitals to monitor GLP-1 prescriptions for unusual patterns, such as frequent visits to different institutions or doses rising abnormally fast, which needs IT support for alerts. Third, special groups: the drugs are not used in pregnancy or breastfeeding, and aspiration risk must be managed around surgery and sedated endoscopy, which the US Wegovy and Zepbound labels also list as a warning. The picture is an AI-generated illustration.
